retirement_age.notes: AOW state pension age is 67 in 2026 and 2027, rising to 67 years and 3 months in 2028; 67 years and 3 months is fixed through 2031. After that it is linked to life expectancy and set five years in advance.

open_questions: Median age: sources based on UN WPP 2024 disagree (41.5 vs 42.6 for 2026); no CBS (Statistics Netherlands) figure was retrieved, so the value is left null.
Population 18,131,238 (end of 2025) is attributed to CBS's February 2026 release but was found on a secondary site (theworlddata.com); verify against the CBS page directly.

Next national (House of Representatives) election: no fixed date found. The Jetten cabinet took office on 23 February 2026; the term end of the House and the date of the next election were not confirmed.
The King's term is lifelong (hereditary) and the Prime Minister has no fixed term, so term_ends is null for both.
